players.product: Hyperscale AI data-center campus with behind-the-meter power (Project Matador, Texas): powered land, powered shell and turnkey data centers leased to AI compute tenants (first tenant TensorWave, 222 MW initial phase)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer TensorWave (fact sheet furnished with the 8-K): the binding 15-year phase one lease for 222 MW of total power capacity ($6.5B of phase one contracted revenue over the initial term) covers 156 MW of critical IT capacity and is backed by credit support from AMD. The credit support agreement with investment-grade AMD is signed; it begins once construction is complete and rent starts, and ends early if TensorWave or its guarantor holds an investment-grade rating for 12 consecutive months (per the fact sheet's disclaimer, AMD's obligations begin only after construction is complete and rent commences on the final delivery phase). Lease terms: 2.5% annual escalators; a turnkey lease in which Fermi develops, builds and delivers; estimated phase one project-level NOI margin of approximately 75% - 80%, with natural gas and variable power charges passed through. Fermi describes TensorWave as an AI cloud built exclusively on AMD Instinct GPUs with >2 GW of secured capacity across its platform.
quarterly_data.figure: 156 MW critical IT capacity; 2.5% annual escalators; estimated phase one project-level NOI margin approximately 75% - 80%

quarterly_data.signal: TensorWave lease delivery schedule (Fermi fact sheet, 8-K): phased delivery begins in Q4 2027 and completes early 2028; TensorWave takes occupancy in phases from Q4 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: phased delivery from Q4 2027, completing early 2028
